## Attendance

The programme board met in April 2021. Present were J. Whitfield, S. Rahman, Priya Anand, R. Adeyemi, A. Okonkwo, K. Lindqvist. J. Whitfield chaired the meeting. The board confirmed that the attendance record was complete and that matters were considered under the agreed programme arrangements.

## Performance

The board reviewed the available performance information for the reporting period. There were 1529 captures for April 2021. The backlog stood at 139, and 2 letters remained recorded. Members noted these figures and agreed that performance information should continue to be monitored through the programme board.

## Items

The board considered CHG-0120 HbA1c reported in mmol/mol. The item was noted, with a further update to be provided through the usual governance process.

The data protection impact assessment for the pilot is still a draft with the data protection officer. The board recognised that the assessment remains subject to completion and agreed that its progress should continue to be tracked.

## Actions

The chair will circulate actions following the meeting. The relevant owners are to provide updates on CHG-0120 HbA1c reported in mmol/mol and on the data protection impact assessment for the pilot. Performance information, including captures, backlog and letters, will remain under review at the next programme board discussion.
